Author: Sansflaire
Name: Local Collidables
Punchline: Adds invisible collision barriers around locally-spawned objects.
Description: Hooks the RMI (raw movement input) pipeline to intercept player movement before it reaches the game server. When the player attempts to walk into a registered barrier volume (placed around locally-visible props), the movement component pointing into the barrier is zeroed and a sliding response is computed. The server only ever sees the player stop moving naturally.
